label: Glass 3D (WebGL)
description: George's cake-ascent animation re-staged in WebGL with the Data Core glass. Hero: the whole loop on the dark hero. White modules, same scene inverted: the shortlist shows only the three tiers and the star; Step 1 draws the rings and data frame and undraws them in sequence; Step 2 builds the tiers as lines only (front halves of the cap rings, dotted walls, swags); Step 3 the top tier and the star with every detail. Tuner: press T.
